target_in_paper: Section 2.1, Problem 2.11*: "Is the group ring of a right orderable group embeddable in a Skew field?"

refined_question: For every right-orderable group G, is the group ring of G embeddable, as a ring, in some skew field?
justification: The draft is targeting Section 2 on right-ordered groups, not Section 1. In Section 2.1 the paper states exactly Problem 2.11*: "Is the group ring of a right orderable group embeddable in a Skew field?" The surrounding introductory paragraph in Section 2 defines the right-orderable setting and shows that Section 2 is the correct ambient context. The only nearby sharpening supplied by the paper is in Section 2.3, where the authors note that A. I. Malcev and B. H. Neumann proved the analogous statement for two-sided orderable groups. So the paper-faithful refinement should stay exactly at the right-orderable level, add only the explicit ring-embedding phrasing, and avoid importing extra hypotheses or a more specific coefficient convention that the paper itself does not state.
